name: slug
rule: Lowercase ASCII A-Z; keep ASCII a-z and 0-9; replace each maximal run of other characters with one hyphen and strip edge hyphens.
body:
import re
return re.sub('[^a-z0-9]+', '-', ''.join(chr(ord(c)+32) if 'A' <= c <= 'Z' else c for c in text)).strip('-')

name: collapse_spaces
rule: Split on Python whitespace and join tokens with one ASCII space.
body: return ' '.join(text.split())

name: strip_prefix
rule: Remove one leading prefix if present; empty prefix leaves text unchanged.
body: return text[len(prefix):] if prefix and text.startswith(prefix) else text

name: strip_suffix
rule: Remove one trailing suffix if present; empty suffix leaves text unchanged.
body: return text[:-len(suffix)] if suffix and text.endswith(suffix) else text

name: common_prefix
rule: Return the longest shared leading substring, case sensitive.
body:
i = 0
while i < min(len(left), len(right)) and left[i] == right[i]:
    i += 1
return left[:i]

name: common_suffix
rule: Return the longest shared trailing substring, case sensitive.
body:
i = 0
while i < min(len(left), len(right)) and left[-1-i] == right[-1-i]:
    i += 1
return left[len(left)-i:]

name: mask_tail
rule: keep is a nonnegative integer. Replace all except the last keep code points with *, preserving length; keep=0 masks everything.
body:
n = max(0, len(text) - keep)
return '*' * n + text[n:]

name: initials
rule: Take the first code point of each whitespace-separated word, uppercase it using str.upper, and concatenate.
body: return ''.join(word[0].upper() for word in text.split())

name: escape_pairs
rule: Replace each backslash with two backslashes and each vertical bar with backslash-bar; process original characters once.
body: return ''.join(chr(92) + c if c in (chr(92), '|') else c for c in text)

name: rotate_text
rule: Rotate left by offset modulo length; negative offsets rotate right; empty text returns empty.
body:
if not text:
    return text
k = offset % len(text)
return text[k:] + text[:k]

name: stable_unique
rule: Keep first occurrence of each integer, in encounter order.
body: return list(dict.fromkeys(items))

name: compress_runs
rule: Keep the first integer of each adjacent equal run, preserving run order.
body: return [x for i, x in enumerate(items) if i == 0 or items[i-1] != x]

name: chunks
rule: size is positive. Return successive list slices of size, keeping a short final slice.
body: return [items[i:i+size] for i in range(0, len(items), size)]

name: windows
rule: size is positive. Return every full overlapping window of size in start order; omit incomplete windows.
body: return [items[i:i+size] for i in range(len(items)-size+1)]

name: interleave
rule: Alternate left then right elements while either remains; append the longer tail.

name: flatten_once
rule: Concatenate rows in row order, flattening exactly one level.
body: return [x for row in rows for x in row]

name: partition_even
rule: Return [evens, odds], preserving encounter order within each list.
body: return [[x for x in items if x % 2 == 0], [x for x in items if x % 2 != 0]]

name: move_zeros
rule: Move all zeros to the end, preserving nonzero order and number of elements.
body: return [x for x in items if x != 0] + [0] * items.count(0)

name: take_until
rule: Return elements before the first stop value, excluding it; return all if absent.
body: return items[:items.index(stop)] if stop in items else items[:]

name: drop_until
rule: Return elements starting at the first start value, including it; absent means empty.
body: return items[items.index(start):] if start in items else []

name: invert_groups
rule: Group input keys by their values; group order follows first value occurrence and key order follows encounter order.

name: select_keys
rule: Return present requested keys in request order; repeated requests appear only once at their first position.
body: return {k: mapping[k] for k in keys if k in mapping}

name: omit_keys
rule: Remove requested keys, retaining remaining insertion order; absent/repeated requests have no effect.
body: return {k: v for k, v in mapping.items() if k not in keys}

name: merge_sums
signature: left: dict[str, int], right: dict[str, int]
rule: Sum values for common keys; key order is left keys then new right keys.
body:
out = left.copy()
for k, v in right.items(): out[k] = out.get(k, 0) + v
return out

name: rename_keys
signature: mapping: dict[str, int], names: dict[str, str]
rule: Rename using names or keep the original key; on destination collision the last value wins, while the first destination position is retained.
body: return {names.get(k, k): v for k, v in mapping.items()}

name: counts
rule: Return each string count with keys in first-encounter order.

name: group_lengths
rule: Group strings by code-point length, retaining first length occurrence and input order/duplicates within groups.

name: pairs_last
rule: Each pair is [string key, integer value]. Make a dict; last value wins but first key position is retained.
body: return dict(pairs)

name: sort_values
rule: Return keys sorted by ascending value; preserve insertion order for ties.
body: return sorted(mapping, key=mapping.get)

name: dict_delta
signature: before: dict[str, int], after: dict[str, int]
rule: Return keys present in after that are new or have changed values, in after order. Exclude removed keys.
body: return {k: v for k, v in after.items() if k not in before or before[k] != v}

name: prefix_sums
rule: Return inclusive running sums in input order.
body:
out = []
total = 0
for x in items:
    total += x
    out.append(total)
return out

name: differences
rule: Return next minus previous for every adjacent pair; length below two returns empty.
body: return [b-a for a, b in zip(items, items[1:])]

name: sign_counts
rule: Return [negative count, zero count, positive count].
body: return [sum(x < 0 for x in items), items.count(0), sum(x > 0 for x in items)]

name: sum_distinct
rule: Sum distinct integers, counting each value once; empty returns 0.
body: return sum(set(items))

name: product_nonzero
rule: Multiply nonzero values; if none exist return the empty product 1.
body:
total = 1
for x in items:
    if x: total *= x
return total

name: weighted_sum
rule: Lists have equal length. Sum pairwise products, preserving duplicate contributions; empty returns 0.
body: return sum(v*w for v, w in zip(values, weights))

name: gcd_all
rule: Return nonnegative greatest common divisor of all integers; empty and all-zero input return 0.
body:
import math
return math.gcd(*items)

name: parity_runs
rule: Count maximal adjacent runs of equal parity; empty returns 0.
body: return sum(i == 0 or x % 2 != items[i-1] % 2 for i, x in enumerate(items))

name: argmax_first
rule: Return index of first maximum; empty returns None.
body: return items.index(max(items)) if items else None

name: nearest_zero
rule: Return value with smallest absolute value; ties choose the smaller signed value; empty returns None.
body: return min(items, key=lambda x: (abs(x), x)) if items else None

name: clamp
signature: value: int, low: int, high: int
rule: low <= high. Return value limited to the inclusive [low, high] interval.
body: return min(high, max(low, value))

name: wrap
signature: value: int, low: int, high: int
rule: low < high. Wrap value into the half-open interval [low, high) using integer modulo.
body: return low + (value-low) % (high-low)

name: ceil_div
rule: divisor is positive. Return the mathematical ceiling of value/divisor as an integer without floats.
body: return -(-value // divisor)

name: round_multiple
rule: step is positive. Return nearest multiple of step; ties choose the larger numeric multiple, including for negatives.
body:
q, r = divmod(value, step)
return (q + (2*r >= step)) * step

name: interval_overlap
signature: a: int, b: int, c: int, d: int
rule: a<=b and c<=d. Return length of intersection of half-open intervals [a,b) and [c,d).
body: return max(0, min(b, d)-max(a, c))

name: split_budget
rule: total is nonnegative and count positive. Split total into count integers differing by at most one; larger shares come first.
body:
q, r = divmod(total, count)
return [q+1]*r + [q]*(count-r)

name: pad_right
signature: items: list[int], size: int, fill: int
rule: size is nonnegative. Append fill until size is reached; never truncate an already longer list.
body: return items[:] + [fill]*max(0, size-len(items))

name: trim_edges
rule: Remove all leading and trailing occurrences of value, preserving interior occurrences.
body:
a, b = 0, len(items)
while a < b and items[a] == value: a += 1
while b > a and items[b-1] == value: b -= 1
return items[a:b]

name: safe_get
signature: items: list[int], index: int, default: int
rule: Use Python negative indexing when in bounds; otherwise return default.
body: return items[index] if -len(items) <= index < len(items) else default

name: normalize_slice
signature: length: int, start: int, stop: int
rule: length is nonnegative. Normalize start and stop like a step-1 Python slice; return [normalized start, normalized stop] without forcing stop >= start.
body:
a, b, _ = slice(start, stop).indices(length)
return [a,b]

name: pluck
signature: rows: list[dict], key: str, default: int
rule: Return row.get(key, default) in row order; row values are integers.
body: return [row.get(key, default) for row in rows]

name: index_last
rule: Every row has key with string value. Map that value to a shallow row copy; last row wins, first key position is retained.
body: return {row[key]: row.copy() for row in rows}

name: group_rows
rule: Every row has key with string value. Group shallow row copies by value, retaining first group order and row order including duplicates.

name: sort_rows
rule: Every row has key with integer value. Return shallow row copies sorted ascending by key, stable on ties.
body: return [row.copy() for row in sorted(rows, key=lambda row: row[key])]

name: filter_rows
signature: rows: list[dict], key: str, value: int
rule: Keep shallow row copies whose key exists and equals value; missing keys never match.
body: return [row.copy() for row in rows if key in row and row[key] == value]

name: sum_column
rule: Sum integer values at key; missing keys contribute zero.
body: return sum(row.get(key, 0) for row in rows)

name: project_rows
rule: Return each row projected to present requested keys, in request order with repeated keys collapsed; retain all rows.
body: return [{k: row[k] for k in keys if k in row} for row in rows]

name: number_rows
rule: Copy each row and set _index to start plus its zero-based position, overwriting any existing _index; other key positions remain unchanged.
body:
out = []
for i, row in enumerate(rows):
    copy = row.copy()
    copy['_index'] = start+i
    out.append(copy)
return out

name: distinct_rows
rule: Every row has key with string value. Keep a shallow copy of the first row for each distinct key value in encounter order.
body:
seen = set()
out = []
for row in rows:
    if row[key] not in seen:
        seen.add(row[key])
        out.append(row.copy())
return out

name: transpose_records
signature: rows: list[dict], keys: list[str], default: int
rule: Return a dict of requested columns in first request order; each list contains row.get(key, default) in row order. Repeated keys collapse.
body: return {k: [row.get(k, default) for row in rows] for k in keys}

name: line_numbers
rule: Split with str.splitlines; return lines prefixed with 1-based number followed by colon and one space. No synthetic final line for a trailing newline.
body: return [f'{i}: {line}' for i, line in enumerate(text.splitlines(), 1)]

name: word_lengths
rule: Return code-point lengths of whitespace-separated words in order.
body: return [len(word) for word in text.split()]

name: join_nonempty
rule: Join strings that are not exactly empty; whitespace-only strings are retained.
body: return separator.join(x for x in items if x != "")

name: replace_words
rule: Split on whitespace; replace entire case-sensitive tokens once via replacements and join with one space. Replacement text is not processed again.
body: return ' '.join(replacements.get(word, word) for word in text.split())

name: split_first
rule: separator is nonempty. Return [before, after] split at first separator; absent yields [text, empty string].
body:
a, _, b = text.partition(separator)
return [a,b]

name: split_last
rule: separator is nonempty. Return [before, after] split at last separator; absent yields [text, empty string].
body:
a, sep, b = text.rpartition(separator)
return [a,b] if sep else [text, ""]

name: truncate
signature: text: str, limit: int, marker: str
rule: limit is nonnegative. If text length <= limit return unchanged. Otherwise return a prefix plus marker of total length <= limit; if marker exceeds limit return its first limit code points.
body:
if len(text) <= limit: return text
if len(marker) >= limit: return marker[:limit]
return text[:limit-len(marker)] + marker

name: ascii_digits
rule: Keep only ASCII characters 0 through 9, in original order.
body: return ''.join(c for c in text if '0' <= c <= '9')

name: title_tokens
rule: Split on whitespace; uppercase the first code point and lowercase the remaining substring of each token; join with one space.
body: return ' '.join(w[0].upper()+w[1:].lower() for w in text.split())

name: char_counts
rule: Count each Unicode code point, case sensitive, with keys in first encounter order, including whitespace.

name: rotate_list
rule: Rotate left by offset modulo length, allowing negative offsets; empty returns empty.
body:
if not items: return []
k = offset % len(items)
return items[k:] + items[:k]

name: explicit_order
rule: priority contains unique strings. Sort listed strings by priority, preserving duplicate order, then append unlisted items in original order.
body:
rank = {x: i for i, x in enumerate(priority)}
return sorted(items, key=lambda x: rank.get(x, len(rank)))

name: intersection
rule: Return distinct common values in first left occurrence order.
body: return list(dict.fromkeys(x for x in left if x in right))

name: difference
rule: Return all left elements absent from right, retaining left order and duplicates.
body: return [x for x in left if x not in right]

name: union
rule: Return distinct values in first encounter order across left then right.
body: return list(dict.fromkeys(left + right))

name: frequencies_sorted
rule: Return [value,count] pairs sorted by descending count, then ascending numeric value.

name: run_lengths
rule: Return [value,count] pairs for adjacent equal runs in input order; separate nonadjacent equal runs.

name: expand_runs
rule: Each run is [integer value, nonnegative count]. Concatenate repeated values in run order; zero count contributes nothing.
body: return [value for value, count in runs for _ in range(count)]

name: zip_fill
signature: left: list[int], right: list[int], fill: int
rule: Return two-element lists at corresponding positions through the longer input; fill missing positions with fill.
body: return [[left[i] if i < len(left) else fill, right[i] if i < len(right) else fill] for i in range(max(len(left),len(right)))]

name: split_on
rule: Split at each delimiter and omit delimiter values. Keep empty segments, including leading/trailing and the one segment of an empty input.
